resource_contracts.description: Owns native JSON contract packages, canonical examples, route snapshots, and compatibility gates.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Contract examples and shape catalogs must stay compact and canonical; generated third-party contract projections must not become source of truth.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Contract changes are review-serialized through native JSON gates and must not publish partially updated examples.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Absent route fields, missing request bodies, and optional payload fields must be represented explicitly in the native JSON shape system.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Retired contract artifacts and generators must be deleted with matching documentation and gate updates.

state_machine.source: Native JSON contract files, example packs, interop gates, repo hygiene, and delivery gate output.

transitions.on: shape and example gates pass
governance docs and runbooks describe the route family
delivery gate runs contract checks
branch CI and repo hygiene pass
route snapshot, example, or forbidden artifact check fails

invalid_operations: accepting removed operations without version bump

required_tests: styio-cloud-control-plane contract gate in unit, integration, regression, smoke, and fuzz modes
registry and hosted contract gates for touched packages

resource_contracts.description: Owns the C++ platform service kernel, daemon entrypoint, route dispatch, mTLS identity parsing, job lifecycle, and service configuration.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: HTTP payloads, job requests, and artifact metadata must be bounded or represented by object keys before being copied across service boundaries.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Job claim and completion behavior must be single-owner; production queue state must use Postgres row locking before multi-worker promotion.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing identities, routes, jobs, workers, object-store settings, and database configuration must return structured failure envelopes.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Worker-owned jobs, heartbeat state, temporary artifacts, and daemon resources must define cleanup on completion, cancellation, and failure.

state_machine.source: StyioCloudRouter, styio-cloudd self-test, Postgres migration SQL, ObjectStore policy, and native service tests.

transitions.on: config and mTLS policy validate
job request is accepted
registered worker claims job
worker submits terminal success
worker submits terminal failure
client cancellation is accepted

invalid_operations: serving internal routes without mTLS identity
using object payloads instead of object keys for durable artifacts

required_tests: native StyioCloudService tests for route matching, identity, object keys, Postgres SQL, and job lifecycle

resource_contracts.description: Owns registry control-plane contracts, registry v2 compatibility, mirror freshness, replay cursor semantics, and regional node runbooks.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Registry metadata, mirror snapshots, and artifact references must be keyed by immutable object references rather than duplicated into control-plane payloads.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Authoritative writes, mirror replay, and freshness publication must expose explicit origin and cursor state before multi-region promotion.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing mirror cursors, lagging freshness, absent package objects, and unavailable origins must be explicit states.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Failed mirror sync and partial registry writes must be replayable or rolled back to the last published freshness cursor.

state_machine.source: Registry contract gates, registry v2 schemas, mirror synchronization docs, and platform control-plane mirror route examples.

transitions.on: mirror sync starts from an accepted origin
required objects and indexes are available
cursor is behind the origin checkpoint
failed sync records a replay cursor
replay reaches the promoted cursor
required object or metadata validation fails

invalid_operations: serving promoted freshness without required objects
accepting anonymous writes on mirror read origins

resource_contracts.description: Owns platform documentation structure, team runbooks, docs stats, source hygiene, and post-commit CI evidence.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Docs indexes and reports must be generated from source files and must not copy obsolete contract text into new governance pages.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Docs and gate changes must update the owning team runbook and DOC-STATS in the same delivery.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing Purpose, Last updated, collection README, collection INDEX, or ownership runbook entries must fail docs audit.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Generated caches, temporary audit output, and retired workflow artifacts must stay untracked unless they are intentional reports.

state_machine.source: docs-audit, team-docs-gate, repo-hygiene-gate, delivery-gate, CI workflows, and docs team runbooks.

transitions.on: docs-index output is current
team runbooks and DOC-STATS cover touched surfaces
docs audit and repo hygiene pass
delivery gate and CI pass
metadata, ownership, or hygiene gate fails

invalid_operations: claiming docs completion without runbook ownership

security_boundaries: Authentication, authorization, and mTLS identity implementation may be public when it uses documented standard protocol behavior.
Privacy and PII payloads must not be committed in control-plane examples, contract packs, reports, or logs.
Password storage is not a production styio-cloud responsibility; any password fixture must be fake test data.
Secret, token, key, and credential material must stay private even when registry key-generation helper code is public.
Production private material, certificates, signing keys, registry role keys, and generated key bundles are offline or not committed to GitHub.
Permission matrix and route authorization behavior for platform service, object store, job, worker, and registry mirror routes must be covered by regression tests.
Deployment security config must document TLS, mTLS, CORS, CSRF, cookie, debug exposure, and regional-node boundaries where applicable.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence is required before release or external deployment gates pass.
DAST black-box penetration security regression must cover deployed platform, registry mirror, and regional-node HTTP surfaces before public deployment.
Runtime secret manager or KMS key rotation owns production certificates, signing keys, hosted tokens, and registry credentials.
Rate limit, anti replay nonce, and idempotency boundaries must be documented for platform service, job, worker, object-store, and registry mirror routes.
Log redaction and audit log rules must prevent request tokens, certificates, object keys, and credentials from being written to logs.
SSRF egress allowlist and URL allowlist boundaries must cover registry mirror fetches, object-store calls, and outbound control-plane requests.
Command execution must use subprocess allowlists and reject shell injection surfaces for deployment, registry, and maintenance helpers.

ci_contract.submit_readiness: A styio-cloud service version is submittable when `platform-adaptation / linux-ci-gate`, `test / smoke`, and `test / golden-standard` all pass.
